authoring.ai_policy: AI or heuristics may propose authoring material but may not establish evidence facts or issue a RISU assurance verdict.

batch_design.null_result_policy: A batch with no regressions remains a valid result.
batch_design.stopping_rule: Enroll the first 8 eligible units under the frozen selection procedure. Do not replace or extend units based on RISU verdict. If diversity gates cannot be met using eligible units, report INSUFFICIENT_DIVERSITY rather than outcome-driven substitution.
batch_design.unit: one independently developed agent-facing or API/tool projection of a version-bound consequential effect

change_control.after_external_timestamp: No in-place edits. Any change requires a numbered amendment with reason, timing, affected fields, and explicit statement of whether candidate screening had begun.
change_control.after_first_verdict: No change to selection, stopping, inclusion/exclusion, result handling, or adjudication for Corpus 0.1.

diversity_gates.note: Diversity is a predeclared design constraint, not a verdict quota.

external_timestamp.acceptable_mechanism: public Git commit of the exact protocol bytes; optional Sigstore/Rekor attestation may be added without changing the protocol bytes
external_timestamp.reason: No dedicated RISU Verify public repository is currently available through the connected GitHub account. This local seal must be published unchanged before corpus screening begins.

purpose: Prospectively test whether the development Version-Bound Effect profile transfers across independently developed projections without outcome-based case selection.

exclusion: case selected because a known RISU-detectable regression is already documented
toy or RISU-authored target except explicit controls
insufficient evidence to identify source and target operations
case whose material consequence is not version-bound under the accepted declaration
case requiring expansion of the frozen scientific core before enrollment
inclusion: operation can cause a consequential write or state transition
operation has a plausible version/revision/precondition semantic relevant to the effect
source operation and projected/agent-facing operation can be pinned to public or otherwise reproducible evidence
bounded VBE worlds can be declared without inspecting a RISU verdict
carrier-specific evidence can be separated from semantic interpretation
